title: Extract tinker's PROP-030 backlog-trend pre-flight into monitor/scripts/compute-backlog-metrics.js (self-applied)
problem: The PROP-030 backlog-trend pre-flight lived as ~120 lines of inline JS in tinker.md (plus a ~26-line PROP-117 Detector B block). Two recurring bug classes survived prompt-level self-fix annotations: (1) RUN_ID env-passing — each MCP bash call is a fresh shell, so rows on 2026-08-09 and 2026-08-10 landed with missing/wrong tinker_run_id despite the 2026-08-11 self-fix note; (2) the fixed_at field-name hazard — closed-issues.json timestamps closure as fixed_at, and a closed_at-only read silently zeroes closed-velocity. The 08-12 Mode 3 context-load audit also flagged tinker.md at +8.6% growth, nearing the 10% moderate line, and named this block the extraction candidate.
fix: New clone-invoked script monitor/scripts/compute-backlog-metrics.js computes all PROP-030/034/038/043/085/105/117/148 metrics, appends the queue-history.jsonl row, and evaluates every threshold tier (incl. the 2026-07-30 small-base floor and Detector B with the poller-HNOTE 24h check), printing thresholds_fired[]/suppressed_percent_trips[]/detector_b as conclusions. --run-id is a required CLI arg (kills the env-passing class); fixed_at is hardcoded in the closed-velocity read (kills the field-name class). FAIL-LOUD: exit 2 = no row appended. tinker.md section replaced with a 3-line invocation + threshold table + act-on-output instructions (723 -> 609 lines, -15.8%). Script registered in workspace-sync.md NEVER_PUSH (clone-invoked-only class, per check-prune-resurrection.js precedent). Follows the helper-extraction lineage of PROP-050/066/106.
verification: Dry-run output on 2026-08-14 matched the manually-computed row for run 2026-08-14T02-40 on every metric (16/0/0/13/8/0 | velocity 2/31/+29 | baby 0, verify 3, commission 0 | root_fs 3076MB, closed_issues 3.35MB, burst 0, sessions_fs 9243MB).
verification_pattern: cd $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) 2>/dev/null || cd .; if [ -f monitor/scripts/compute-backlog-metrics.js ] && grep -q 'compute-backlog-metrics.js' monitor/prompts/tinker.md && grep -q 'compute-backlog-metrics.js' monitor/prompts/workspace-sync.md && node monitor/scripts/compute-backlog-metrics.js --run-id VP-TEST --dry-run >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo FIXED; else echo STILL_BROKEN; fi
notes: Self-applied per tinker's standing self-audit remit (the block being extracted is tinker's own pre-flight; no other agent's behavior changes). The prompt retains the threshold table and interpretation rules — judgment stays in the prompt, computation moves to code.
